name: useThermometer
summary: Non-contact infrared temperature measurement on Google Pixel Pro hardware.
plain: Reads surface and ambient temperatures from the dedicated far-infrared (FIR) sensor on Pixel 8 Pro, 9 Pro, 10 Pro, and 11 Pro devices. Allows adjusting material emissivity and measurement mode.
description: Interfaces with the Melexis MLX90632 non-contact FIR temperature sensor integrated into Google Pixel Pro camera visors. Surfaces calibrated surface temperatures in both Celsius and Fahrenheit along with ambient die temperature. Supports configurable emissivity correction factors (0.10 to 1.00) and measurement modes (object, body, ambient). Reports unavailable on non-Pro models.

params.name: initialEmissivity
params.desc: Surface emissivity factor from 0.1 to 1.0, defaulting to 0.95 (organic/skin/water).

returns.name: isSupported
returns.desc: Whether the device hardware features the FIR non-contact temperature sensor.

returns.name: surfaceTemperatureC
returns.desc: Calibrated surface temperature in degrees Celsius (°C), or null if absent/unmeasured.

returns.name: surfaceTemperatureF
returns.desc: Calibrated surface temperature in degrees Fahrenheit (°F), or null.

returns.name: ambientTemperatureC
returns.desc: Sensor die / internal ambient temperature in degrees Celsius (°C), or null.

returns.name: emissivity
returns.desc: Current material surface emissivity coefficient (0.1 to 1.0).

returns.name: error
returns.desc: Error message if sensor probing failed.

returns.name: setMode
returns.desc: Sets the measurement mode to 'object', 'body', or 'ambient'.

returns.name: refresh
returns.desc: Probes the hardware sensor for a fresh reading.

actions.name: setEmissivity(value)
actions.desc: Updates the material surface emissivity coefficient.

actions.name: setMode(mode)
actions.desc: Switches the calculation mode between 'object', 'body', and 'ambient'.

actions.name: refresh()
actions.desc: Requests an updated temperature reading from hardware.

agentNote: Available exclusively on Pixel Pro devices (8 Pro, 9 Pro, 10 Pro, 11 Pro). Non-Pro devices return isSupported: false with null readings.
